forward_patch:
--- original

@@ -1,6 +1,26 @@
 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m5a93kj4rdfgmgycba9n46w9
+  text: |-
+    Investigation: the line comes from the Swift Build engine (the default SwiftPM build system), not from this package and not from a stale .build.
+
+    Toolchain: Apple Swift 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1, clang-2100.3.34.1), swift-driver 1.168.6, Xcode 27.1 (27A9275), target arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0. The `.build/out/...` and `.build/manifest.pif` layout shows that `swift build` and `swift test` use the Swift Build (swiftbuild) backend by default.
+
+    1. Clean build of this repo: `swift package clean && swift build --build-tests` printed the line again, during the `[13 / 2079] mlx-swift_Cmlx` step (the resource-bundle target of mlx-swift 0.32.3, rev 19601207). So a stale .build is not the cause.
+    2. Cause: Cmlx declares no `resources:`, but it holds `.metal` sources (Source/Cmlx/mlx-generated/metal/*.metal). Swift Build compiles them into `default.metallib` inside the `mlx-swift_Cmlx.bundle` resource bundle, and that bundle task mutates `<bundle>/Contents/MacOS` without a task that creates the node.
+    3. Minimal reproduction without mlx-swift (scratchpad, `rm -rf .build` first each time):
+       - A package with one Swift target and `resources: [.process("data.txt")]` gives no warning.
+       - A package with one C target (`clib.c` plus one `k.metal` kernel) prints `warning: missing creator for mutated node: ('.../.build/out/Products/Debug/MetalRepro_CLib.bundle/Contents/MacOS')`. It prints on the first build and again on each no-op rebuild.
+       - A package with one Swift target plus one `.metal` file prints the same line for `MS_SLib.bundle/Contents/MacOS`.
+       - The same C+metal package built with `--build-system native` gives no such line. But native prints `warning: '--build-system native' has been deprecated...`, and it compiles only clib.c, with no metallib (MLX needs `default.metallib` at runtime). So native is not a fix.
+       Conclusion: any SwiftPM target with a `.metal` source triggers this warning under Swift Build on this toolchain. It is a toolchain bug.
+    4. Why this package cannot remove it: the `.metal` sources belong to the pinned mlx-swift dependency. Removing them means changing the mlx-swift pin or editing .build/checkouts, and the card forbids both. Package.swift has no setting that suppresses build-system warnings or that picks the build system. The only other route, `--build-system native`, is deprecated, adds its own warning, and does not build the metallib.
+    5. Upstream: searched swiftlang/swift-build and swiftlang/swift-package-manager issues for "mutated node" and found no matching report. A third-party sighting of the same line from a Metal resource bundle on the macOS 27 SDK is at https://github.com/SecondMouseAU/OCCTSwiftViewport/issues/120. Proposed upstream action: file a swiftlang/swift-build issue with the 3-file C+metal reproduction above.
+    6. Separate, first-build-only noise: a clean build also prints Metal compiler `-Wc++17-extensions` warnings from mlx-swift's `mlx-generated/metal/*.h`. They do not repeat on later incremental `swift test` runs, and they are outside this card's scope.
